capability.name: Public MCP servers that changed tools which move value or hold keys
capability.description: Which public MCP servers changed a tool that can move money or touch keys? From HISTOR's daily reads of public MCP servers (about 6,000 tool-list changes a day), the few that matter to an agent that can pay: a tool added that sends, swaps or withdraws; a value-moving tool whose description or schema changed; a wallet address added to or replaced in a tool's description; a new mention of private keys or seed phrases. Filter by time or change id (a poller passes the last cursor), severity, server and flag. Each item names the server, its HISTOR page and the tools; the answer carries the feed's time, cursor and SHA-256. Seven days, rebuilt hourly by fixed rules (money-tools/v1). A flag says what changed, not that a server is malicious.

since.description: ISO time in UTC, or a change id (the last cursor)

server.description: part of a server's name, endpoint or website
